verdict.rationale: Documented program limits, approval stages, and a path to raising them are a fair question for a banking-as-a-service platform, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers accounts, payments, cards, lending, dashboards, and multi-bank support. Nothing in it documents limits, approval tiers, or how limit increases work.

support.subject: As a founder, growth doesn't hit invisible walls — program-level limits, approval stages, and the path to raising them are documented rather than discovered in an email from the bank
